title: Group Fitness Class Passes: which pack a booking or expiration draws from when a member holds more than one
content:
## Scope
This document states the Group Fitness Class Passes basis for which of a member's open class-credit packs is drawn from when the member holds more than one open pack at once, across every tier of the product.

## Basis
When a member holds more than one open class-credit pack, a class booking or an expiration forfeiture of unused credits draws from the pack with the soonest expiration date among that member's open packs. Where two or more of the member's open packs share the same expiration date, the pack that was opened earlier — the one with the earlier purchase date — is drawn from first.

## Points of judgement
- This draw order applies only when more than one open pack exists; a member with a single open pack has every booking and every expiration draw from that one pack by default.
- The ordering is a two-step comparison: first by soonest expiration date, and only as a tiebreaker among packs sharing that same expiration date, by earlier purchase date. A pack with a later expiration date is never drawn from ahead of one with a sooner expiration date, regardless of when either was purchased.
